strings.(벨리알이 무채색으로 변한 아마란스 노바 속 폐허 신전에서 떨어져 있는: (In the ruined temple of Amaranth Nova, now drained of color, Belial notices something on the ground and sighs.)
Ah... I never imagined the God of Despair I spent so long cultivating would meet such an end...
strings.카울리니, 아쉽게 됐지만 어쩔 수 없나 봐. 그래도 마계에서 당신을 부활: Kaulini, it's a shame, but what can we do? Still, I'll look for a way to revive you in the Demon Realm.
strings.그것마저 안 된다면 어쩌겠어. 당신의 끝이 여기까지라고 생각하고 받아들여: And if even that fails, what choice is there? I'll have to accept that this is where your story ends.
strings.(벨리알이 바닥에 떨어진 검은 나비 잔해와 부서진 무기 파편을 주워 거울: (Belial gathers the remains of black butterflies and fragments of a shattered weapon from the ground, then places them inside her mirror.)
There you are, demon of deceit.
You've been watching me for a while now.
Hehe. You knew, and still went about your business so calmly.
I believe I asked who you were.
strings.(다프네의 이름을 듣는 순간, 벨리알이 놀라며 흥미롭게 쳐다본다.): (At the sound of Daphne's name, Belial looks up in surprise and interest.)
strings.후후, 마계에서도 최악으로 알려진 마녀가 날 찾아오다니 재미있네. 그래,: Hehe. How amusing. A witch infamous even in the Demon Realm comes looking for me. So, what do you want?
There is something I wish to do. I don't know whether you are aware, but to meet that old man... I need your help.
strings.(다프네가 환하게 웃으며 벨리알에게로 슬쩍 다가가 지팡이를 들어 가볍게: (Smiling brightly, Daphne steps closer to Belial and raises her staff to tap Belial lightly on the shoulder.)
And with that, you are the 'last' item on my list. I am honored, Belial...
strings.(힐다가 주위를 둘러보다가 앞에 서 있는 헤카테를 발견하고 놀란다.): (Hilda looks around and starts in surprise when she sees Hecate standing before her.)
Didn't I die? Hecate, tell me. What happened...?
Forgive me for bringing you here without your permission.
Your soul should have ceased to exist, but the will of regeneration within you saved it.
Your body, however, was lost. It could not return.
strings.그럼 아마란스 노바에 있는 그 녀석은 어떻게 됐지? 내가 도움이 되지 못: Then what happened to that fool in Amaranth Nova? Was I no help after all?
strings.아니다. 넌 도움이 됐다. %s의 활약과 이리스 그 아이의 각성으로 마신: You helped. Through %s's efforts and that child Iris' awakening, the Demon God Kaulini was defeated...
strings.그 상태가 바로 노인과 손을 잡은 우로보로스가 바라는 바였다. 네 영혼이: Your condition was exactly what Ouroboros, who joined forces with the old man, had wanted. To swallow your soul before it vanished...
Without even knowing what that would mean...
strings.하아, 이리스, 그 아이의 짐이 내게 왔어야 했는데…. 너희를 빨리 마녀: Ah, I should have borne Iris' burden myself... I should have freed you all from the burden of being witches sooner...
Too many souls have vanished because of my weakness and the old man's games.
strings.나와 그 녀석을 위협했던 것도…, 이리스 여신에게 성계신 자리를 내놓으라: So when you threatened me and that fool... And demanded that Goddess Iris surrender her place as God of the Astral Realm...
I understand now... I'm sorry I was so angry with you.
strings.어렴풋이 알고 있었어. 나의 세계는 어쩌면 이미 멸망했을지도 모른다는 걸: I had some idea. That perhaps my world had already been destroyed.
strings.마신 카울리니는 그런 걸 느끼지 못했는지, 날 이미 없는 세계선에 던져: Demon God Kaulini apparently couldn't sense it. She threw me into a timeline that no longer existed and seemed satisfied...
strings.이제 나도 없으니 그 녀석도 편해지겠네…. 조금만 더 빨리 이야기해 주지: Now that I'm gone, that fool can rest easy too... You could have told me a little sooner... If this was how it was destined to end anyway.
No... Your destiny is by no means hopeless.
It has merely been cast behind a black veil, where no one can see...
And like all of you who tried to save a world of despair, even in timelines that had perished...
